args.prompt:
Decide whether the EVIDENCE supports the CLAIM. Judge only the evidence text; ignore your own knowledge.
EXPLICIT = the evidence directly states the claim.
IMPLICIT = the evidence clearly implies the claim without stating it.
NONE = the evidence only mentions the subject, or does not support the claim.
CLAIM: "Caballito" is worth visiting for travellers interested in history.
EVIDENCE: """Caballito Parque Centenario Popular neighbourhood park, and geographical centre of Buenos Aires City. See more ❯ Bernardino Rivadavia Museum of Natural Sciences Discover dinosaur fossils and insect collections at this exciting museum. See more ❯ Historic tramway An original experience to enjoy with young visitors."""
Reply with one JSON object: {"level":"EXPLICIT|IMPLICIT|NONE","rationale":"<one sentence>"}
